items: 【All-in-One Magnetic Charging Station for Apple Devices】Simplify your setup with a 3-in-1 wireless charger designed specifically for iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Compatible with MagSafe cases, it supports iPhone 12–17 series, Apple Watch Series 3–9/Ultra/SE, and AirPods 2/3/Pro/Pro 2—keeping your ecosystem powered up from a single source. (Note: Please use Mag-Safe phone case or without case for wireless charging)

【Fast Wireless Charger Foldable Stand】Effortlessly charge for iPhone at a lightning-fast 15 W, for Apple Watch at a reliable 2.5 W, and for AirPods at a steady 5 W—all at once. Each device charges independently, without affecting the performance of the others. It takes only 2-3 hours to fully charge your devices, allowing you to enjoy the convenience of a single, fast, unified charging solution.[Note: To charge at full speed, please use a PD charger of 20 W or higher.]

【Upgrade Powerful Mag-Safe Charger Stand】Mag-Safe charger 3 in 1 makes fast charging safe and easy. The built-in super strong magnet makes alignment instantly and precisely, just 1 second to achieve lightning fast wireless charging. The magnetic charger can hold your iPhone horizontally and vertically, or in any directions, the phone charging area can adjust the angle up and down by 120°, so you can enjoy hands-free viewing at any angle.

【Streamlined Power for Your Apple Ecosystem】 Many smart devices have become companions in our lives, and it has become important to simplify how to power them. Carrying multple charging cables to power your devices can become a hassle, but our 3 in 1 charging station for apple can take on the work of three cables by connecting to just one power adapter. Note: Does not come with an adapter, you need to pair it with an adapter of at least 25W for fast charging!

【Your Safety Companion】Our wireless chargers have passed various certifications with professional circuit design and intelligent protection technology. It has overcurrent, overvoltage, and temperature control to ensure safe and fast charging of your device. This wireless charging station is not only the best charging accessory for the desktop and bedside, but the perfect gift for your friends and family! You will get a 3 in 1 charging station, a 5ft charging cable, a user guide.
